floater.name: wolf_skis
floater.title: Skis and Snowboards
floater.text: Ride down the mountain. The steeper the slope, the faster you go.

button.label: Skis
button.name: skis_btn
button.tool_tip: A pair of skis and poles.

button.label: Snowboard
button.name: board_btn
button.tool_tip: A snowboard. You stand sideways on it.

button.label: Put them on
button.name: put_on_btn
button.tool_tip: They appear at your feet and you stand on them. Your free pair is in your inventory: Objects > Skis and Snowboards.

button.label: Take them off
button.name: take_off_btn
button.tool_tip: Stand up. They go back to your inventory, ready for next time.

button.label: Show the Ski HUD
button.name: show_hud_btn
button.tool_tip: Bring back the HUD across the bottom of the screen.

check_box.label: Show the Ski HUD while I ride
check_box.name: hud_auto
check_box.tool_tip: Speed, steepness, your run time, jumps and style points across the bottom of the screen.
